summary: Fixed both S11 export regressions; VM gates pass, linked-audio failures are zero, and unrelated corpus failures are unchanged.
body:
Changed:

- [export.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs): audio representation and traversal budget.
- [export/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs:680): seven focused tests.
- [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs): removed only the two assigned exemptions.

No importer changes, dependencies, or commits. Task completed and locks released.

API unchanged: `pub fn export(project: &Project, sequence: ItemId, format: Format, opts: &ExportOptions) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)>`. The scene implementation remains `pub(crate) fn export(p: &Project, seq_id: ItemId, opts: &ExportOptions, report: &mut Report) -> Result<String>`.

The audio defect came from exporting both implicit video audio and explicit audioMix placements. Muting the video layer silences its audio; it does not remove that placement. Matching linked pairs now use the video's own audio, preserving linkage, volume, mute, and transition audio behavior. Independent audio uses an audio-only asset; picture-only video assets declare `hasAudio="false"`. This follows [XSD video audio semantics](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:1195), layerType/audioTrackType documentation, Schematron R15, and [sr-deliver audio placement](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-deliver/src/audio.rs:379).

Link preservation covers one-to-one root pairs with matching clocks and representable static volume. Independently edited or animated audio retains its audioMix placement and reports lost edit linkage; nested audio remains explicitly placed. No scene-render code was borrowed; `sr-deliver/src/audio.rs` was consulted only.

Default effects and parameters previously exhausted the content budget despite emitting no additional nodes. They now consume a separate checked 4,000,000-item traversal allowance. Existing content, XML-size, and depth bounds remain; oversized projects still return errors.

TDD ran entirely on the VM. Both original corpus tests were first run with `--ignored`:

| Test | Observed red assertion → green |
|---|---|
| `scene_corpus_linked_audio` | Clip count 2 → 3 → passes |
| `scene_corpus_10000_siblings_export` | 0 exports instead of 2; export budget exhausted → 2 exports and 4 re-imports |
| `scene_export_linked_audio_once_with_link_and_level` | 1 audioTrack instead of 0 → passes |
| `scene_export_independent_audio_once_and_picture_only` | 1 audio clip instead of 0 → passes |
| `scene_export_linked_audio_independent_controls_use_mix` | 2 audio clips instead of 1 → passes |
| `scene_export_shared_source_linked_and_unlinked_uses` | 4 audio clips instead of 2 → passes |
| `scene_export_linked_audio_with_transition_keeps_links` | 4 audio clips instead of 2 → passes |

Focused green run: 44 export tests passed. Oversized-track rejection and traversal-budget boundary tests also passed.

Final VM gate: `cargo fmt --check`, clippy with `-D warnings`, and all interchange tests passed: **322 passed, 0 failed, 6 unrelated ignores**. `cargo xtask wasm` passed for **51 crates**.

Pinned corpus before → after: **1,343 cases**, **1,676 exports/schema-oracle checks**, and **3,352 successful re-imports** unchanged; failure records **255 → 183**, with **zero new failure records**.

| Category | Failing cases before → after |
|---|---:|
| linked-audio | 18 → 0 |
| 10000-siblings, separate hostile case | 1 → 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 → 11 |
| material-override | 6 → 6 |
| external-expression | 122 → 122 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 → 18 |
| voxel-palette | 14 → 14 |
| generated-id | 12 → 12 |

The full corpus command exits 101 solely for those unchanged categories. All 72 removed failure records belong to linked-audio. Detailed results and adjacent raw logs are saved in [verification.json](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/fixexport/verification.json).
